name: dither-patterns-demo
title: Dither Patterns Demo
description: All 17 patterns as same-size background tiles, each labelled with its pattern id.

files.content:
import { Dither, type DitherPattern } from "@/registry/magicui/dither" const patterns = [ "horizon", "glow", "aurora", "waves", "clouds", "gruvbox-dusk", "nord-orbit", "kanagawa-moonrise", "orbit", "meridian", "eclipse-rose", "ridgeline", "contour", "dunes", "eclipse-nord", "orb", "veil", ] as const satisfies readonly DitherPattern[] export default function DitherPatternsDemo() { return (
{patterns.map((pattern) => ( {pattern} ))}
) }
